title: The Third Prediction of the Passion
description: On the way up to Jerusalem, Jesus goes ahead of his disciples, who are amazed and afraid. For the third time he takes the twelve aside and predicts exactly what will happen: The Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the law, condemned to death, and handed over to the Gentiles, who will mock him, spit on him, flog him and kill him - but he will rise again three days later. [ref:Mark 10:32-34|Markus 10:32-34]
